thread:
Priya: opened a docs PR to add a migration guide for tracing-hook v2 and clarify KV-prefetch cost attribution. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299

Sam: nice. can we include a tiny table that maps old metric names -> new ones? customers keep getting confused about latency vs latency_p50_ms.

Priya: yes planning that. also adding a short 'what changed' bullet list at top. example mapping row: latency -> latency_p50_ms.

Casey: heads up: the Rust SDK snippet still references trace.sampling in examples. i'll update it to trace.sampler and add a note about runtime backward-compat.

Alex: thanks Casey. also please add a tiny Ruby snippet — we only have node/py/go currently. a customer asked specifically for Ruby examples during onboarding.

Sam: on KV-prefetch: propose a 2-paragraph explanation under 'Cost breakdown' that explains prefetch is billed as tokens generated by the prefetch worker and appears under route X in the console. link to telemetry doc.

Priya: adding that. also adding a diag image for the cost flow. Jamie from design said they'll create an updated SVG. tagging them in the PR comments.

Casey: linkcheck before merge will likely flag a stale anchor in console/tracing#examples. I can run the local checker: `./scripts/link-checker console --fix`.

docs-bot: lint + linkcheck running for PR#1299 — lint: ok; linkcheck: 1 broken anchor (console/tracing#example-ruby).

Priya: thanks bot. i'll fix the anchor and push a small commit. also adding release note: "tracehook v2: config key rename (trace.sampler), metric renames, and KV-prefetch cost clarifications"

Alex: quick accessibility nit: when the design SVG lands, make sure screenshot alt text says 'Cost breakdown by route with KV-prefetch highlight'.

Sam: will also add a 'how to verify' section with steps to run the telemetry example and check the p50 metric in the dashboard. short command: `curl -X POST ...`

Casey: tests: i'll add a tiny smoke test that loads the Ruby snippet and ensures YAML frontmatter has 'tracing:' and that example link resolves. plan to open follow-up PR for test infra if needed.

Priya: great. if all green i'll merge after approvals. ping me if you want to pair on wording for the migration timeline (we should recommend keeping old key for 2 weeks).

docs-bot: deploy-preview created at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/1299 — visual diffs showing updated cost diagram pending.

Alex: SGTM. thanks team. once merged i'll add a short note to the docs changelog and email mid-market onboarding folks about Ruby snippet.

Priya: done for now. will follow up on any linkcheck alerts. cheers.
